analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($48.52) vs SMA5/20/50 ($57.43/$72.08/$107.52): below short/mid-term trends, bearish zone
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($125.39/$123.86): below long-term trends, strongly bearish
· 52-week position (9.5%) + near historical lows

· RSI trajectory (34.7→34.2) + sustained oversold, maintaining downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.0443→-0.1445) + improving but still negative, weak trend reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (at lower band $31.71) + approaching lower band, wide band width at 112.02%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($48.50) + basis (near current price, distant from Pivot S1 $23.21)
· Swing resistance ($50.09) + potential for short-term bounce on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not met, Lower High not met) → sideways phase
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80x) + subdued conviction in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) + entry/wait conditions: consider buying on break above $50.09 resistance and RSI recovery above 50
